paragraphs.text: DeepSeek Harness plugin for Jetformat: Office to PDF and PDF tools via the local CLI
Registers four tools that run the local Jetformat CLI: Word, Excel, and PowerPoint to PDF, text extr
action, file validation, and PDF info, merge, extract, and render. No MCP server; files stay on your
ile validation, and PDF info, merge, extract, and render. No MCP server; files stay on your machine.
Install the CLI and sign in first:

dsh plugin --profile web add @jetformat/dsh-plugin
# or from GitHub
dsh plugin --profile web add git
The plugin spawns the `jetformat` binary (set `JETFORMAT_BIN` to override). The CLI contacts jetform
at.com to sign in, to deduct credits for paid commands, and to send an anonymous usage ping (`jetfor
mat telemetry off` to stop). It never uploads files.
MIT for this plugin. The Jetformat CLI is closed-source: https://jetformat.com/terms
